facts.statement: Atlantidosteus fossils date from the Emsian to the Eifelian stages.
The genus Atlantidosteus was described by Lelièvre in 1984.
Atlantidosteus is an extinct homostiid arthrodire found in Morocco and Queensland during the Early to Middle Devonian.
facts.quote: Atlantidosteus is an extinct genus of homostiid arthrodire from the Early to Middle Devonian of Morocco and Queensland.

facts.statement: Atlantidosteus belongs to the clade Migmatocephala and is more closely related to Homostius than to Antineosteus.
facts.quote: Atlantidosteus is part of the clade Migmatocephala, closer related to Homostius, than Antineosteus.

facts.statement: Atlantidosteus belongs to the parent group Arthrodira.
Atlantidosteus is classified in the class Placodermi.
